reviews.review:
I'm no techpriest but..

BUY THIS GAME.

Gearhammer 40ks of War.

3rd person action shooter in the Warhammer 40k universe.
it has aged a good bit, and not to well overall, but let's break it down

Pros:
 - great gameplay, every weapon and gadget feels rewarding to use
 - Warhammer 40k
 - the campaign is engaging
 - story is typical Warhammer fare. it's quite fun

Cons:
 - as any action game it becomes a bit repetitive
 - graphics, especially details, could have used some polishing, sure looks nothing more than 
   average today
 - no real replay value

if you're a Warhammer fan then I think this game is surely a must.

else I'd say it's a decent action game that will keep you entertained for one run.
better get it on a sale

To Quote Total Biscuit. The Codex Astartes does support this game. 

Third Person Action Shooter. Where you play as one of the Ultramarines  Captain Titus during an Ork invasion of a planet. 
This game is definitely one of the good ones out of the mixed bag we had with the Warhammer 40k licensing. 
The executions are fun. The action is great. Though the problem is it does become repetitive.
The graphics were awesome as well. 

I will say this despite playing as an Ultrasmurf it is definitely a good game to play. 
Multiplayer to a degree is weaker just because of less people playing but its easy to make a game for it with friends. 
As for the price. I would recommend getting it if it drops down.
Less cheaters in multiplayer would make it perfect.

Not much diversity, and no skirmish which is always nice to have in any game to promote replayability 9like a bloody palace mode). but overall excellent gameplay and much fun, worthy of any gamer's library who is into either 40k or 3rd person action games.

+ Solid storyline befitting the WH40K universe.
+ Solid mechanics that seamlessly flows from shooting to melee.
+ Excellent thematic carry-overs from the written word of WH40k
